You are estimating development effort for ticket AMSD-1919: a fix to the Go Transit checkout form that makes email validation case-insensitive. Currently, the confirmEmail field comparison in the checkout flow treats "user@example.com" and "USER@EXAMPLE.COM" as different values, causing validation failures when users capitalize or copy-paste with different casing.
__SYSTEM_PROMPT__The work is localized to the checkout form validation logic. The project uses TypeScript with Jest testing. The change involves: modifying the email comparison in CheckoutForm.tsx's validate rule (line 306 area), updating related validation types, and adding or updating test cases in the existing test directory at src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/. No API changes, database migrations, or external service integrations are required.
__SECTIONS__Based on this scope, estimate the iteration count needed to implement the case-insensitive email comparison, add test coverage for the fix, and verify no regressions in existing checkout validation.
